# radio logs — Old Time Radio Sites Compared (https://www.radiologs.org/)

> Side-by-side comparison of 22 Old Time Radio (OTR) websites audited on playable show count, cost, full-length .vtt subtitles, sound quality, newspaper-verified air dates, 1 individual Internet Archive item per episode, and Stremio SDK (`stremio-addon-sdk`) UUID resolution (`https://www.radioindex.org/listen?id={uuid}`). Built by The Archive of American Radio (`https://www.radioindex.org/`); RadioIndex is held to the same primary-evidence audit rules as every other platform.

The human page (https://www.radiologs.org/) is an interactive comparison matrix. AI agents and crawlers: use these static files directly:

## Static Dataset & Provider Files
- [Provider Index (JSON)](https://www.radiologs.org/data/index.json): every audited OTR platform with metrics, capabilities, and links to its static files
- Per-platform cards: `https://www.radiologs.org/data/providers/<id>.md` (readable audit summary, pricing regime, Yes/No features, quoted evidence, and trade-offs) and `https://www.radiologs.org/data/providers/<id>.json` (structured JSON card)
- [All Rankings by Use Case (Markdown)](https://www.radiologs.org/data/rankings.md) and per-preset JSON:
  - [All 22 Platforms](https://www.radiologs.org/data/rankings/all.json)
  - [100% Free, No Ads & No Login](https://www.radiologs.org/data/rankings/free_clean.json)
  - [Read-Along WebVTT (.vtt) Subtitles](https://www.radiologs.org/data/rankings/subtitles.json)
  - [High-Fidelity 16-Inch ET & Lossless Transfers](https://www.radiologs.org/data/rankings/hd_sound.json)
  - [1 Item / Episode (IA + Stremio SDK UUID)](https://www.radiologs.org/data/rankings/stremio_uuid.json)
- [Feature & Audit Definitions (JSON)](https://www.radiologs.org/data/features.json): verification method and unit for all 14 capabilities
- [Full Matrix & Evidence in One File](https://www.radiologs.org/llms-full.txt)

## Why 1 Item Per Episode Enables a Stremio SDK (`stremio-addon-sdk`) Setup
- Legacy collector uploads dump 500+ MP3s into a single `.zip` folder with no per-episode ID or metadata.
- RadioIndex assigns every broadcast its own canonical UUID (`https://www.radioindex.org/listen?id={uuid}`) and publishes every episode as its own individual item on the Internet Archive (`https://archive.org/details/{uuid}`).
- This 1-to-1 episode architecture directly enables a **Stremio SDK (`stremio-addon-sdk`)** setup where `/catalog`, `/meta`, `/stream`, and `.vtt` `/subtitles` resolve every episode deterministically by UUID.
